title: RNA-seq of hepatic biopsies taken from patients with chronic liver disease presenting with different aetiologies (HCV, FLD) and fibrosis stages.
description: To determine gene signatures associated with advanced liver fibrosis, we undertook RNA-sequencing of liver biopsies from patients presenting with different aetiologies (HCV or FLD) and fibrosis stages (n=69 patients).

samples.title: Sample 36
samples.description: Protocols: Liver tissue and serum were collected at the time of liver biopsy following an overnight fast for 8-10 hours and stored at -80˚C. Diagnosis of liver disease was based on standard biochemical and serological assays and consensus histological assessment of the liver biopsy by 2 blinded, experienced pathologists. Fibrosis is measured using the modified METAVIR scoring system, where 0 is no fibrosis, 1 is portal fibrosis without septa, 2 is portal fibrosis with few septa, 3 is portal fibrosis with numerous septa without cirrhosis and 4 is cirrhosis. Alcohol code is based on the following code (from in house lab classifications): 0 = NONE; 1 = >0 - RWA (recommended weekly allowance) (140g/wk women, 210g/wk Men); 2 = > RWA for sex to <350g/wk women, <420g/wk Men; 3 = ≥350g/wk women, ≥420g/wk Men; Total RNA was isolated from human liver biopsy tissue using TRI Reagent (Sigma Aldrich), as per the manufacturer’s instructions. RNA quality was assessed using the Agilent 2100 BioAnalyser and samples with an RNA integrity number ≥ 6.0 were included for RNA-sequencing. Up to 1 µg of RNA was used to synthesize mRNA libraries using the TruSeq Stranded Total RNA (Ribo-Zero GOLD) library preparation kit (Illumina), as per the manufacturer’s instructions.

Diagnosis of liver disease was based on standard biochemical and serological assays and consensus histological assessment of the liver biopsy by 2 blinded, experienced pathologists. Fibrosis is measured using the modified METAVIR scoring system, where 0 is no fibrosis, 1 is portal fibrosis without septa, 2 is portal fibrosis with few septa, 3 is portal fibrosis with numerous septa without cirrhosis and 4 is cirrhosis. Alcohol code is based on the following code (from in house lab classifications): 0 = NONE; 1 = >0 - RWA (recommended weekly allowance) (140g/wk women, 210g/wk Men); 2 = > RWA for sex to <350g/wk women, <420g/wk Men; 3 = ≥350g/wk women, ≥420g/wk Men; Total RNA was isolated from human liver biopsy tissue using TRI Reagent (Sigma Aldrich), as per the manufacturer’s instructions. RNA quality was assessed using the Agilent 2100 BioAnalyser and samples with an RNA integrity number ≥ 6.0 were included for RNA-sequencing. Up to 1 µg of RNA was used to synthesize mRNA libraries using the TruSeq Stranded Total RNA (Ribo-Zero GOLD) library preparation kit (Illumina), as per the manufacturer’s instructions.
